caption: Cheerful children's nursery song for preschool TV, bright ukulele, glockenspiel, hand claps, bouncy bass and light drums, a warm friendly male cartoon lion singing, catchy sing-along chorus, happy, major key, polished modern kids music production
lyrics:
[Verse]
Roar, roar, Rory roars!
Stomp your paws on the jungle floor!
Clap, clap, one, two, three,
Come and roar along with me!

[Chorus]
We're the Paws and Claws Club, hey hey hey!
We roar and we dance and we play all day!
Wiggle your tail and shake your mane,
Paws and Claws Club, sing it again!
